verdict.rationale: The evidence points to Babylon.js's own headless capability: a first-party server-side support docs page and a NullEngine class in the typedoc, plus offscreen rendering under scene management. However, the pack only shows the titles and URLs of these pages, with no content describing how headless execution works or how to use it in CI pipelines. missing for 10: documented detail of NullEngine/server-side behaviour and limits, explicit CI automation guidance (e.g. headless rendering or testing in CI), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
